<function=python>

res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':36},{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':36}])

def bb(p):
    if not p: return None

    blk=[(r,c) for r in range(9,25) for c in range(13,51) if a[r][c]=='Y']
    dot=[(r,c) for r in range(40,49) for c in range(13,51) if a[r][c]=='b']
    print(i,"blk",bb(blk),"dot",bb(dot))
